title: One line of the evaluator's journal (runs/results.jsonl)
description: Written in eval mode: one line per finished episode (event 'finished', or no event in journals written before it existed) and one per episode replaced by reset/load while running (event 'abandoned': no reward, the steps it spent). An episode still running when the input ends or a close arrives is a truncated 'finished' row with ended_by 'close'. episode_run counts the rows of the same episode_id in one evaluator session (1 for the first; a replayed seed shows as 2, 3, ...). With a journal key every line also carries seq, prev and mac (HMAC-SHA256 chain, auditgym/journal.py). `secret` is "set" when the evaluator had a generation secret and "none" when it had not (the value is never written); absent in older journals. `source` is "seed" (episode generated by the evaluator) or "load" (read from a directory; `source_sha256` is the content hash of that directory); absent in older journals, which verify-journal treats as seed.

steps_total.description: Every step taken, the submit included; inspection_steps counts the actions before the submit only. Absent in journals written before this field existed.
